plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a man named Ron Pandolfi, who he says seems to be part of JASON, a group of top scientists who advise the US government. According to Michels, Pandolfi also keeps turning up in the UFO world, which suggests a link between elite government science and the UFO question.
